en.t: After that, I began writing this letter.

units.source_text: 由于平时不常写东西，总是不能够随心所欲地表述事情的经过或想法，感到颇为痛苦。

en.t: Since I am not used to writing, I found it quite painful that I could never express events or thoughts as freely as I wished.

units.source_text: 我险些就要放弃对你的这份义务了。

en.t: I almost abandoned this duty I owed to you.

units.source_text: 但是，尽管几度停下笔来，都未能作罢。

en.t: But even though I put down my pen several times, I could not give it up.

units.source_text: 不到一个小时，又想写了。

en.t: Before an hour had passed, I wanted to write again.

units.source_text: 也许，你认为我是个很看重履行义务的人吧，我也不想予以否认。

en.t: Perhaps you think I am someone who places great importance on fulfilling obligations; I do not intend to deny it.

units.source_text: 正如你知道的，我是个独往独来的孤僻之人，因此算得上是义务的义务，

en.t: As you know, I am a solitary and unsociable person who keeps to himself, and so obligations worthy of the name

units.source_text: 遍观我的周边，没有在任何角落扎下根。

en.t: have not taken root anywhere around me, no matter where I look.

units.source_text: 不知是有意还是无意，我过着尽量减少义务的生活。

en.t: Whether deliberately or unconsciously, I lived in a way that reduced my obligations as much as possible.

units.source_text: 但是，并非对义务冷漠，我才变成这样的，

en.t: But it was not because I was indifferent to obligations that I became this way;

units.source_text: 反倒是敏感过头，没有精力忍受刺激，才变得如你所看到的那样，消极度日。

en.t: rather, I was too sensitive and lacked the energy to endure stimulation, and so I came to live passively, as you have seen.

units.source_text: 因此，一旦答应了人家，却不能兑现承诺，我就会极其厌恶自己。

en.t: Therefore, once I have promised someone something, I feel intense self-disgust if I cannot keep that promise.

units.source_text: 即便是为了避开这种自我厌恶的心情，我也不能不再度拿起放下的笔，给你写这封信，以履行我对你的承诺。

en.t: Even if only to avoid that feeling of self-disgust, I had no choice but to pick up the pen I had laid down and write this letter to you, fulfilling my promise to you.
